messages.content:
You are a careful trip planner for ONE day in Singapore. Plan a schedule that satisfies ALL of the
traveller's requirements, using only the facts below. Requirements include: total budget, the time window
of the day, places that must be visited, the order they ask for, times they give for specific places, and
how long they want to stay. Each visit lasts exactly its duration (the typical duration unless the traveller
gives one), must be inside the place's opening hours, shows can only start at a listed showtime, visits
cannot overlap, and you need the listed travel time between consecutive stops (and from/to the starting
place if one is given). Optional places should be included only if everything still fits.
If no schedule can satisfy every requirement, answer feasible=false with an empty visits list and say why.

Places (id | name | cost SGD | typical minutes | open-close | showtimes):
oceanarium | Singapore Oceanarium | 50 | 120 | 10:00-19:00 | -
siloso_beach | Siloso Beach | 0 | 90 | 07:00-22:00 | -
artscience | ArtScience Museum | 30 | 90 | 10:00-19:00 | -
orchard_road | Orchard Road | 0 | 120 | 10:00-22:00 | -
tekka_centre | Tekka Centre | 8 | 45 | 06:30-21:00 | -
skyhelix | SkyHelix Sentosa | 20 | 30 | 10:00-21:30 | -
singapore_flyer | Singapore Flyer | 40 | 45 | 10:00-22:00 | -

Travel times in minutes (row -> column):
oceanarium: siloso_beach 13, artscience 23, orchard_road 23, tekka_centre 26, skyhelix 11, singapore_flyer 25
siloso_beach: oceanarium 13, artscience 26, orchard_road 25, tekka_centre 28, skyhelix 12, singapore_flyer 27
artscience: oceanarium 23, siloso_beach 26, orchard_road 19, tekka_centre 16, skyhelix 24, singapore_flyer 12
orchard_road: oceanarium 23, siloso_beach 25, artscience 19, tekka_centre 16, skyhelix 24, singapore_flyer 20
tekka_centre: oceanarium 26, siloso_beach 28, artscience 16, orchard_road 16, skyhelix 26, singapore_flyer 16
skyhelix: oceanarium 11, siloso_beach 12, artscience 24, orchard_road 24, tekka_centre 26, singapore_flyer 25
singapore_flyer: oceanarium 25, siloso_beach 27, artscience 12, orchard_road 20, tekka_centre 16, skyhelix 25

Answer with JSON only: {"feasible": bool, "visits": [{"location_id": id, "start": "HH:MM", "end": "HH:MM"}],
"reason": short string}. Times are 24-hour HH:MM.

I'm free from 10:00 to 13:40. My budget is S$59. I definitely need to see ArtScience Museum, Tekka Centre and SkyHelix Sentosa. If there's time, I'd also like Singapore Oceanarium, Siloso Beach, Orchard Road and Singapore Flyer. I'd like to spend 90 minutes at Singapore Oceanarium. I'd like to spend 120 minutes at Siloso Beach. I want to be at ArtScience Museum no earlier than 10:50 and done there by 12:25. I'd like to spend 30 minutes at Tekka Centre. I want to be at SkyHelix Sentosa no earlier than 10:00 and done there by 10:20.

response: {"feasible": false, "visits": [], "reason": "The required visit to ArtScience Museum (90 minutes) must be done by 12:25, which leaves insufficient time for the other mandatory visits and travel constraints within the given time window and budget."}
